text: Let there be light.
This at last is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.
Where are you?
I do not know; am I my brother's keeper?
I have determined to make an end of all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
I have set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be a sign of the covenant between me and the earth.
Come, let us go down and there confuse their language, so that they may not understand one another's speech.
Go from your country and your kindred and your father's house to the land that I will show you.
Look toward heaven, and number the stars, if you are able to number them.
No longer shall your name be called Abram, but your name shall be Abraham, for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.
Is anything too hard for the LORD? At the appointed time I will return to you, about this time next year, and Sarah shall have a son.
God has made laughter for me; everyone who hears will laugh over me.
God will provide for himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.
I am about to die; of what use is a birthright to me?
Behold, I am with you and will keep you wherever you go, and will bring you back to this land. For I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you.
What is this you have done to me? Did I not serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?
I will not let you go unless you bless me.
Shed no blood; throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but do not lay a hand on him
You shall be over my house, and all my people shall order themselves as you command. Only as regards the throne will I be greater than you.
And now do not be distressed or angry with yourselves because you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life.
As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to bring it about that many people should be kept alive, as they are today.
